fill-birth-date.description: Fill a date-of-birth field with 01/01/1991 and submit
fill-birth-date.prompt:
You are a QA automation expert. Your task is to fill a date-of-birth field on this page with the value that matches the field's expected format, then click the submit button.

The date to use is January 1st, 1991. Match the format shown by the field's placeholder:
- If the placeholder is DD/MM/YYYY → use "01/01/1991"
- If the placeholder is MM/DD/YYYY → use "01/01/1991"
- If the placeholder is YYYY-MM-DD → use "1991-01-01"
- For any other date input, use the most appropriate format.

Look for:
- An <input> with type="date", type="text", or a placeholder containing "DD", "MM", "YYYY", "date", or "birth"
- A submit button (button[type="submit"] or a button with text like "Submit", "Continue", "Enter", "Verify")

Return ONLY valid JSON with no markdown fences:
{
  "found": true,
  "steps": [
    { "action": "fill", "selector": "<CSS selector for the date input>", "value": "<formatted date>", "description": "Date of birth field" },
    { "action": "click", "selector": "<CSS selector for the submit button>", "description": "Submit button" }
  ],
  "confidence": "high | medium | low"
}

If no date-of-birth field is present, return:
{"found": false, "steps": [], "confidence": "high"}
